category: Modern life — fields a spoken revival needs and a classical corpus lacks
label: meals, the restaurant and ordering
note: COVERED. Chapters 97 and 160 already owned bhojanālayaḥ (restaurant) and bhojanam (meal); chapter 265 corrects that stale audit note, retrieves familiar food and drink, bridges known dadāti to the complete request form dadātu, and twice requires a model-free kṛpayā mahyaṃ X dadātu request. This closes one narrow project-defined meal-ordering point, not a complete imperative paradigm or restaurant vocabulary.
